navigation: Steam WindowRouter.Navigate(path, replace=false, matchOnly=false, state) selects history.replace when the second argument is true.
decky_bridge: The Decky Navigation wrapper forwards every supplied argument to the focused Steam window router.
home_back: Steam attempts history.goBack and opens its main menu fallback if no popstate event occurs.
change: Use Navigate(path, true) for sidebar entry, normal exit, setup completion and the recovery-screen exit. Avoid growing the history on each visit.
verification: Actual compiled-plugin handlers tested with React/jsdom and a simulated history, including three repeated visits and input-actionset cleanup.
limit: The Steam client and physical controller were not executed here. Existing entries left by earlier plugin versions are not erased.
